newsitem.title: UK: Canada expected to launch $1.0 bln 5-yr bond soon.
newsitem.headline: Canada expected to launch $1.0 bln 5-yr bond soon.

text.p: Canada will launch a $1.0 billion five-year bond, bankers said on Monday.
"We expect an announcement to be made very soon, possibly even this afternoon," a dealer said.
Spread talk is in the "high single digits" over U.S. Treasury notes.
Merrill Lynch was tipped as lead manager of the transaction but declined to comment on the deal.
Last Thursday the country launched a $450 million bond due January 2001 via Yamaichi. The bond pays a coupon of 5.50 percent.
